**Project**: ExamRadar (考前雷达) -- a course knowledge retrieval and exam prep system built on seekdb (OceanBase) and PowerContext. Python 3.12 + FastAPI backend with static HTML/JS frontend.

### 2. Python Source Files under `examradar/`

All paths relative to `/Users/wanderer/Project/oceanbase/powercontext-camp/.camp/wt/eco-qoder/qoder/app/examradar/`:

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `__init__.py` | Package marker; contains only docstring `"""ExamRadar — 考前雷达"""` |
| `__main__.py` | Entry point for `python -m examradar`; imports and calls `cli.main()` |
| `chunker.py` | Document chunking. Splits Markdown by heading hierarchy (preserving heading path), plain text by paragraphs, PDF slides/papers by page, and exam PDFs by question number (extracting question_no and points via regex). Uses `pypdfium2` for PDF text extraction. |
| `cleaner.py` | Unicode text cleaning for Chinese PDF extraction. Maps Kangxi radicals (U+2F00-2FDF) and CJK Radicals Supplement (U+2E80-2EFF) to standard CJK unified ideographs via a 112-entry mapping table. Removes spaces between adjacent CJK characters (without touching newlines). Collapses blank lines. Strips footer page numbers. Validates CJK character integrity. |
| `cli.py` | Command-line interface with 3 subcommands: `import` (import files/directories with auto-detection of document kind from parent directory name), `sql` (execute SQL against seekdb and display results as a table), `delete-course` (delete all data for a course). |
| `config.py` | Pydantic-settings configuration. Auto-discovers `.env` file by walking up from the package to repo root. Settings include: seekdb connection, PowerContext URL, app host/port, CORS, embedding provider/model/dim, optional LLM config, coverage thresholds, Leitner intervals. |
| `embedding.py` | Embedding generation. Supports two providers: `local` (fastembed with `BAAI/bge-small-zh-v1.5`, 512 dimensions) and `openai` (OpenAI-compatible API). Lazy-loads the local model. Supports optional BGE query instruction prefix (disabled by default). |
| `ingest.py` | Shared document ingestion pipeline. Validates input (doc_kind, file extension, 30MB limit), computes SHA256 for dedup (scoped per course_id), chunks the file, generates embeddings in batches of 16, then atomically imports into seekdb (single transaction; rollback on failure). Records usage events. |
| `main.py` | FastAPI application definition. Sets up CORS middleware, includes route routers (health, documents, search), serves static files, and serves 3 HTML pages (index, import, ask). Runs `ensure_tables()` on startup via lifespan. |
| `pc_client.py` | Minimal PowerContext client. Single function `check_powercontext()` that hits `/health/ready` for the health check endpoint. |
| `seekdb.py` | seekdb database client. Contains: connection management (PyMySQL), idempotent database/table creation (documents, chunks, usage_events with VECTOR/FULLTEXT/structured indexes, all ORGANIZATION HEAP), atomic document import with transaction, SHA256 dedup, hybrid search via `DBMS_HYBRID_SEARCH.SEARCH` with RRF fusion, RRF tie-breaking (by keyword score then semantic score), usage event recording, document listing. |
| `routes/__init__.py` | Empty file (package marker) |
| `routes/documents.py` | Document import endpoint. `POST /api/documents` accepts multipart file upload with course_id and doc_kind form fields. `GET /api/documents` lists documents for a course. |
| `routes/health.py` | Health check endpoint. `GET /api/health` reports status of seekdb connection, embedding model (loads and tests), and PowerContext reachability. |
| `routes/search.py` | Search endpoint. `POST /api/search` accepts query text, course_id, optional doc_kinds filter, top_k, and include_exam flag. Generates query embedding, runs hybrid search via seekdb, resolves document names, returns results with ranking info (RRF score, keyword score/rank, semantic score/rank), plus the search JSON and actual SQL executed. Records usage events. |

### 3. Test Files

All paths relative to `/Users/wanderer/Project/oceanbase/powercontext-camp/.camp/wt/eco-qoder/qoder/app/tests/`:

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `__init__.py` | Package marker (just `import pytest`) |
| `conftest.py` | Empty conftest (just `import pytest`) |
| `test_chunker.py` | **Unit tests** for chunker.py: Markdown heading splitting (basic, path preservation, long section splitting, empty input, Chinese headings), plain text paragraph splitting, exam PDF question splitting (11 questions, points extraction, total=100), fallback for non-exam text. |
| `test_cleaner.py` | **Unit tests** for cleaner.py: Kangxi radical normalization, CJK radical supplement mapping, standard CJK unchanged, mixed text, full-width punctuation preservation, space removal between CJK chars, newline preservation, CRLF normalization, ideographic space removal, footer page number stripping, CJK validation, is_mostly_cjk checks. |
| `test_embedding.py` | **Unit tests** for embedding query-instruction handling (no model load): verifies instruction prefix is applied when configured and omitted by default. Uses monkeypatching. |
| `test_ingest.py` | **Unit tests** for ingest validation (no DB access): valid/invalid doc_kind, valid/invalid extension, no extension, file too large, boundary size, all allowed kinds. |
| `test_integration.py` | **Integration tests** (require running seekdb, gated by `EXAMRADAR_IT=1` env var, marked `integration`): connection check, import idempotency, cross-course import, SHA256 scoping, UTC ISO timestamps, transaction rollback on failure, exam PDF chunking (11 questions, 100 points), slides PDF chunking (9 pages with correct headings), embedding model, query instruction, hybrid search SQL, usage event recording, and 6 parametrized acceptance queries verifying first-hit correctness. |
| `test_search.py` | **Unit tests** for search JSON construction: text escaping (quotes, backslash), basic structure (query/knn/rank/size), filter presence in both branches, source fields, query text escaping, multi_match covering content+heading, JSON serializability, knn k value, exam inclusion. |

### 5. Frontend / HTML Files

All paths relative to `/Users/wanderer/Project/oceanbase/powercontext-camp/.camp/wt/eco-qoder/qoder/app/static/`:

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `index.html` | **Homepage** (考前雷达). Shows system health status (seekdb, embedding model, PowerContext), quick links to import/search, and a list of imported documents for a given course ID. Fetches `/api/health` and `/api/documents`. |
| `import.html` | **Document import page** (导入资料). File upload form with course ID, document kind selector (notes/slides/exam/paper), and file picker (accepts .md/.txt/.pdf). Shows import status (success/skip/error). Lists already-imported documents. Posts to `/api/documents`. |
| `ask.html` | **Search/query page** (问笔记). Text area for questions, course ID input, "include exam" checkbox. Calls `/api/search` and renders results with source attribution (file, page, question number, heading path), RRF/keyword/semantic scores. Uses marked.js for Markdown rendering. Shows first 5 results with "show more" expand. Includes collapsible debug panels showing the search JSON and actual SQL. |
| `css/style.css` | **Global stylesheet**. Clean, modern Chinese-friendly design. Blue header (#0b4f8a), card-based layout, form styling, result items with metadata/scores, quick-links grid, table styling, collapsible details for debug info. |
| `lib/echarts.min.js` | Vendored ECharts 5.6.0 library (for charts, used in planned M2 radar page). |
| `lib/marked.min.js` | Vendored marked.js v15.0.12 (MIT license) for Markdown-to-HTML rendering in search results. |

- **Dependencies**: fastapi>=0.115, uvicorn[standard]>=0.32, pydantic>=2.9, pydantic-settings>=2.5, pymysql>=1.1, httpx>=0.27, python-multipart>=0.0.12, fastembed>=0.4, pypdfium2>=4.30, numpy>=1.26
